messages:
maya: quick q — for the auto-fallback rollout, what's the operator journey when a user sees 'degraded' route? do we show decision id + reason?
jon: we discussed showing a compact card w/ DecisionID, reason, time, and a "view audit" link. also a button to "re-run with primary" for debug cases.
sam: concern: inflight requests — we need to make sure the "re-run" doesn't double-bill tokens or requeue incorrectly. need idempotency key.
jon: agree. plan: console issues a rerun via admin API with header `x-idempotency-key: <decision-id>` -> server ignores duplicate.
anna: telemetry ask: can we surface bucketed counts: fallback_count, fallback_rate, avg-latency-primary, avg-latency-fallback over last 1/5/60m? ops wants 1m spikes.
lee: we'll wire those into per-route dashboard. question on sampling: for audit logs we can't store full inputs; need hashed prompt id + metadata.
maya: +1. compliance wants non-replayable hashes. hashed_prompt_id + salt per-customer.
ops-bot: deploy 1764448000: autofallback-audit-log retention=90d sampling=0.05
sam: edge case: what about degraded mode = "soft-degrade" vs "hard-degrade"? UX should indicate whether operator can manual recover.
jon: propose labels: Soft — sampled routing to fallback, manual undo allowed. Hard — immediate switch with operator override only after cooldown.
anna: add: display cooldown timer and affected request window (e.g., "last 10k reqs").
maya: UI sketch: small pill under route name: `Fallback active • soft • 12% sampled • since 12:02 UTC` -> click for details.
lee: backend needs to emit event `fallback.decision` with fields: decision_id, route, reason, mode, sampling_rate, primary_latency_ms, fallback_latency_ms. we'll log hashed_input_id not full.
jon: api change: POST /admin/routes/:id/fallbacks -> { mode, reason, sampling_rate, override_until }
sam: add validation: if override_until - now > 24h reject, to prevent runaway toggles.
maya: audit playback: can we replay sampled decisions in sandbox? would be great for QA.
anna: yes, but only with redacted inputs, and an option to "replay with synthetic prompt" in the replay UI.
lee: small note: operator perms — only T1+ can trigger hard-degrade. show badge in UI.
ops-bot: alert: fallback.rate_exceeded route=payments threshold=0.25 current=0.31
maya: thanks. next action items: jon to send API sketch, lee to add telemetry fields, sam to add idempotency header, anna to draft UI microcopy.
jon: will do, sending PR in ~2h.
sam: i'll add tests for billing idempotency.
maya: perfect. if anyone wants to pair on the replay UX ping me.
